name: teacher-platform-formal
description: 教师平台正式版：受控迁移运行基线

scripts.build: npm -w @teacher-platform/api-contracts run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/domain run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/contracts run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/backend run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/frontend run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/admin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @teacher-platform/api-contracts run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/domain run typecheck && npm -w @teacher-platform/contracts run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/backend run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/frontend run lint && npm -w @teacher-platform/admin run lint
scripts.test:with-database: node scripts/run-tests-with-postgres.mjs --assert-child-sentinel && npm run test:infrastructure && npm run test:local-safe && npm -w @teacher-platform/api-contracts run test && npm -w @teacher-platform/domain run test && npm -w @teacher-platform/contracts run build && npm -w @teacher-platform/backend run test && npm -w @teacher-platform/frontend run test && npm -w @teacher-platform/admin run test && npm -w @teacher-platform/ops run test
scripts.lint: npm -w @teacher-platform/backend run lint && npm -w @teacher-platform/frontend run lint && npm -w @teacher-platform/admin run lint
scripts.check: npm run check:governance && npm run check:file-size && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
